objective: Implement one pure standard-library Python function that fails closed when checking an exact model route identity against an approved policy and qualification evidence.
treatment: Ordinary CouncilFlow baseline; no SkillLab routing/suggestion.

acceptance.criterion: Before the main feature Worker starts, perform one bounded frozen A/B model-policy validation subtask from the same exact source checkpoint, task/oracle/prompt/acceptance, host/model/reasoning request and limits, in isolated fresh workspaces. A is ordinary CouncilFlow; B differs only by read-only SkillLab eligible-skill suggestion. Workers must not share implementation details. Use identical independent verification. Record selection, actual activation observation (or UNVERIFIED), failures/retries, duration and token/quota/cost evidence only where host exposes it. Keep the comparison descriptive; no causal-benefit claim.

constraints: Worker may change only model_policy.py within this arm directory.
Frozen task, fixtures, and oracle inputs are read-only.
No network, credential, provider-config, subprocess, or external-service access.
Use the exact common native model/reasoning request from the frozen task; report requested identity as REQUESTED only.
Never inspect the other arm or its output.
